text: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company reports record quarterly revenue and profit as advanced-node wafers comprise the majority of sales. High-performance computing exceeds half of revenue, with sub-7nm processes accounting for most wafer output, alongside increased capital spending and global fab expansion.

meta.note: Overseas expansion operates at lower margins, introducing structural variance within a consolidated revenue profile.

text: United Kingdom reports 0.3% GDP growth for November, exceeding forecasts, with services and production expanding while construction contracts. The print follows a revised October decline, revealing sectoral divergence within aggregate output.

meta.note: Monthly volatility and sector offsets limit inference about underlying trend strength.
